avis.texte: I love this product. It doesn’t give your face greasy or feeling harsh. I love the pimple popper too. They really get out the toxins.

I’m prone to cystic acne (thanks to PCOS) and I’ve been using this product for over a month. And let me tell you, this is the only cleanser that doesn’t leave my skin super dry, and keeps my acne away! I wash my face once a day, and at night. The product itself is a thick gel texture, however when you squeeze it on your hands and add some water it becomes the perfect consistency. I also love how it leaves my skin feeling moisturized and love how it doesn’t have a funky smell!
I randomly decided to switch to Curology and I love it. I get cystic acne and my flare ups have been reduced dramatically.

I absolutely love all of curology’s products! This is a medicated face wash it has 2% salicylic acid in it for mild to moderate facial acne. The face wash itself is thick enough it doesn’t run all over but is thin enough it lathers well providing excellent coverage when cleansing your face. I find this face wash is less irritating and less drying than others with benzoyl peroxide as the active ingredient. It also has a nice smell to it but not overpowering or harsh enough it causes irritation. Great value for the price will last awhile as it’s a larger bottle.
works very well.highly recommened .if you have anyone who suffers the acne, totally worth to try.

avis.titre: Did not irritate my sons sensitive skin
avis.texte: I picked up this face wash for my teenage son who’s just starting to deal with some mild acne, and it’s been a great addition to his routine so far. He has pretty sensitive skin, so I’m always cautious about trying new products, but this one hasn’t caused any irritation or redness. It does a nice job of keeping his skin clear without over-drying, which is a big plus. The 2% salicylic acid seems to help with small breakouts and clogged pores, and I like that it also has ingredients to keep the skin balanced and hydrated. He also uses a PanOxyl bar, and we find curology a bit more hydrating,… this cleanser works really well as part of his rotation. He follows it up with a moisturizer, and together it’s been a simple, effective routine. Overall, a solid option for teens with sensitive, acne-prone skin.

avis.titre: Product is made in the USA and is wonderful!
avis.texte: Wow, this product is a HUGE win for me. I don't have acne, but my jaw line breaks out during certain times in my cycle, and I like to use an SA face wash the week before to prepare my skin. This is exactly what I was looking for, and exceeded my expectations. The product itself is SO thick and rich. The face wash is clear, which at first glance looked like it might take a lot of product to get the effectiveness I was looking for. I have found that clear based products just tend to be a bit more diluted than cream based, but I was completely wrong in this case. The face wash is THICK and concentrated. I put a pea sized amount between my fingers and I was having trouble getting it to lather because it was so thick and rich! I got the product to lather so well by using my Clairsonic face wash brush. I think that the vibration of my brush helped with adding friction in a way that I was having trouble doing it with my fingers on my face. The lather is unreal. Thick, bubbly, and smooth. It is luxury in a bottle. The face wash is TRULY fragrance free. As in there is no smell whatsoever. How many times have you used a product that says fragrance free, only for it to have it's own scent? Also, even though this has a mighty 2% salicylic acid in it and is super effective at attacking breakouts, I feel like it's gentle enough to be used every day on sensitive skin. This product is also proudly made in the USA and I LOVE using USA made products because of because I feel more confident in

My skin is oily and breakout-prone and a lot of acne washes leave it tight and squeaky. This one cleans without that stripped feeling, which I think is the niacinamide and glycerin doing their thing. No fragrance, no sting around active spots, and my skin feels moisturized. I use it morning and night and a small amount goes a long way, so the tube lasts. Not an overnight fix, but after a few weeks my skin feels calmer. I think it's pretty effective, it's a good value, and I'm glad I switched.

This comes in a big bottle that will last for a long time and its from a known brand which provides good ance face wash which is gentle on the skin. I use these daily for months and i had no issues with the product. I actually will reup on this as i like the smell and how well it worked. I recommend this even though it is on the pricer side from other similar products.

avis.titre: gentle yet effective cleanser for oily skin that is truly unscented
avis.texte: After trying another curology facial cleanser that was too gentle for my oily skin, I was excited to see how this performed. From the first use I was impressed by the effectiveness of this wash, without the stripping that is often accompanied with the use of acids. I cannot leave this on my skin too long, or it does start to dehydrate a little, but it's been a solid cleanser and has not caused any adverse reactions. 5 oz for 16 wasn't a bad deal for a cleanser that stands up to the test of an oily complexion. This leaves my skin feeling soft and helps to keep it more clear of breakouts, which I've always been prone to. No fragrance is solid for those with sensitivities to such additives.

avis.titre: Another Curology product for the win!
avis.texte: I am a huge fan of the Curology brand, and have been buying their products for years! I have actually moved to their sister brand, Agency, for my own skincare needs (Agency is focused on anti-aging products, while Curology focuses on anti-acne products), but I still purchase Curology for my teens, and their products are top-notch! The best part of Curology products is that I trust them to be non-comedogenic and fragrance-free. They are great at creating products that won't inflame acne or cause breakouts while still being effective for the skin. This cleanser is no different – it lathers well, and I love the inclusion of Lactic Acid and Niacinamide along with the Salicylic Acid. It rinses and cleanses well, and I have my kids following this with a lightweight moisturizer. It's a simple routine that works great for breakout-prone skin. I will 100% order this (and other Curology/Agency products) again!

This is the first Curology product I’ve tried, and I was pleasantly surprised. When I first dispensed it onto my fingers, it seemed similar to a lot of other cleansers out there. It is clear— but not too runny, which I liked right away. The big difference showed up once I started washing my face. It actually thickens as you work it in, almost like it turns into a light mask, which I wasn’t expecting but ended up really liking. It feels like it’s doing a deeper clean without being harsh. After rinsing, my face felt very clean and refreshed. There’s very little fragrance. The tube is also larger than I expected, so you’re getting a good amount for the price. Overall, very happy with my order and glad this was my introduction to Curology. Will definitely keep using it!

Acne cleansers are generally too harsh on my sensitive skin. This cleanser did not bother my sensitive skin👍🏻 I use Curology’s gentle cleanser on a regular basis so I figured I would try this one. I was not disappointed. There is no fragrance, which is definitely a plus for me. It is a light gel consistency. It makes my skin feel clean without being dry or tight. It is gentle enough for my super sensitive skin. The price is a bit high, but everything is overpriced these days. The cleanser helps with keeping my skin clear so I would say it is effective. I would recommend this cleanser.

Curology 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash for Acne Prone Skin I liked this a lot. It helped calm down a breakout quickly. I was worried it would be drying because salicylic acid can sometimes wreck my skin barrier, but I didn’t have that issue here. The texture is thicker and creamier than most acne washes, which I actually preferred. The tube is also pretty large at 5 oz. At $16, I think this is very reasonably priced. I would absolutely buy this again.
